caption: The drawing depicts a single metal teapot with a curved handle and a long, narrow spout. The body of the teapot is bulbous and rounded, tapering toward the top, where it is topped with a dome-shaped lid. The lid is ornamented with elongated, vertical decorative ridges and is finished with a rounded finial. The teapot’s handle is wide, dark, and elaborately swept in a wave-like curve, attached to the upper left of the pot; it appears textured, perhaps simulating wood or a patterned surface. The spout is attached to the lower right of the teapot’s body and angles outward and upward before narrowing to a small opening. The drawing is rendered in shades of black, gray, and white, created with pencil on a light, off-white background. There is a signature and date at the lower right reading “Amelia Toecio - 1936 -”. No other objects are present in the composition.
title: Silver Teapot
